reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent, atmospheric short mission with strong contextual navigation and clear objective progression; manual moving patrol combat remained less reliable to interpret than assisted travel and close coil interactions. Two wins do not alone establish quality or enjoyment.
reasons.controls: Large reachable labeled touch controls, successful entry tap/fire and scene swipe, simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag actually sampled. Patrol tracking required corrections and lacked immediate confirmation; continued held-burst rearming comfort cannot be judged because capture releases contacts.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, armor/open coil cycle and pressured deck upload provided understandable progression and distinct tasks. Patrol encounters introduced damage and correction attempts. Assisted travel dominated mission completion, so independent navigation/combat depth and sustained enjoyment are not established.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive teal/amber industrial rain scene, weapon silhouette, signage, memory-saved cards and polished terminal panel. Audio and physical performance unassessed.
reasons.usability: Contextual HOLD ROUTE/APPROACH/RECOVER, threat direction cue, paused planning map and explicit upload prompt were helpful. Route could recover from combat detour. Numbered boss markers initially invited an ineffective distant burst.
reasons.readability: Health, ammunition, objective, OPEN/ARMORED and segmented OFF indicators were clear at 390x844. Distant patrols and vulnerable coil details were small against dark architecture; scene text can be tiny.

unassessed: Tools, AIM/zoom, weapon switching, jump and settings menus
